name: Static Ad Generation
description: SOP + guardrails for generating static image ads for any of the brand's products, pinned to the Gemini reference-image flow (gemini-3-pro-image, reference-images-only prompting, 4x5 aspect enforcement). Reads the brand-product profile for reference images, allowed/banned claims, and disclaimers per product. Produces an HTML brief and updates a per-brand asset ledger. Self-onboarding; install stages files only.
